items.explanation: Marta = ella. The preterite of hablar for él, ella, usted is habló, with an accent on the o.
optionNotes: Without the accent, hablo is the present: “I speak”.

items.explanation: -er and -ir verbs take -í in the yo form of the preterite: comí.
optionNotes: Comió is for él, ella, usted.
Como is the present; anoche needs the past.

items.explanation: The tú form of the preterite ends in -aste for -ar verbs: llegaste.
optionNotes: The tú form of the preterite has no final -s.
Llegó is for él, ella, usted.

items.prompt: Ayer (yo) ___ las llaves por toda la casa. (buscar)
items.explanation: Verbs in -car write -qué in the yo form of the preterite: busqué.
optionNotes: -car verbs change c to qu before é: busqué.
Buscó is for él, ella, usted.
Busco is the present; ayer needs the past.
